data.one_liner: Control GIF playback, speed, frames, and loops using a Flutter animation controller.
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to control GIF playback speed, jump to specific frames, and loop within a frame range using a Flutter animation controller. It also provides GIF caching to avoid reloading frames on every iteration.
use_when: You need to manipulate GIF playback speed or play/pause GIFs programmatically.
You want to control GIF frames or play within a specific frame range.
You need GIF caching to optimize loading performance.
avoid_when: You only need to display a static or automatically looping GIF without programmatic control.
You are using complex vector animations like Rive or Lottie.
strengths: Provides frame-level control over GIFs via an animation controller.
Includes built-in GIF caching to prevent reloading frames.
Supports custom frame rates and durations.
weaknesses: Not documented for complex non-GIF animation formats.
Relies on external package limitations for GIF decoding.

alternatives.name: lottie
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want to use scalable vector animations instead of raster GIFs.

alternatives.name: flutter_animate
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a general-purpose animation library for widgets rather than specific GIF frame control.

alternatives.name: rive
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need interactive, state-driven vector animations.
